description: Two-panel composite figure of scatter plots (property maps) comparing the mechanical properties of Fe–Mn–Al–C lightweight steels at room temperature; there are no micrographs or spectra. (a) plots yield and ultimate tensile strength (MPa, y axis 0–1800, gridlines every 200) against elongation (%, x axis 0–50, gridlines every 5) on a blue gridded background, with the text "γ-based duplex (γ+α/δ)" in the lower left. Its legend maps carbon content C (wt%) — 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.2 — to marker shapes and open (YS) versus filled (UTS) fill, and Mn (wt%) 8, 10, 11, 12 to red, pink, blue and dark-green colours. (b) repeats the axes over wider ranges (strength 0–2000 MPa, elongation 0–100%) and adds two shaded fields with arrow labels: a grey elongated region labelled "single-γ" and a cyan region labelled "γ-based duplex (γ+α/δ)". Its legend lists C rows ≤0.5 to >1.2 and Mn windows 12~18 (magenta), 18~25 (orange), 25~28 (purple), 28~40 (dark red). Panel (b) shows the duplex field confined to low elongation (~5–45%) while the single-γ grey field extends to ~100% elongation at lower strength.

subfigures.description: Scatter plot of yield and ultimate tensile strength (MPa, 0–1800) versus elongation (%, 0–50) for steels with average Mn content; blue gridded field, annotation 'γ-based duplex (γ+α/δ)'. Legend: C (wt%) 0.5–1.2 as marker shapes with open symbols = YS and filled = UTS, and Mn (wt%) 8/10/11/12 as red/pink/blue/dark-green colours. Points cluster roughly between 400 and 1450 MPa at 5–45% elongation.

Scatter plot of the same quantities for high-Mn steels over a wider range (strength 0–2000 MPa, elongation 0–100%), with two shaded fields: a cyan region arrow-labelled 'γ-based duplex (γ+α/δ)' at low elongation and a grey region arrow-labelled 'single-γ' extending to ~100% elongation. Legend lists C (wt%) ≤0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, >1.2 (open = YS, filled = UTS) and Mn (wt%) ranges 12~18, 18~25, 25~28, 28~40 in magenta, orange, purple and dark red.

observations.observation: Panel (a) axes are 'Yield and ultimate tensile strength (MPa)' (0–1800, tick spacing 200) versus 'Elongation (%)' (0–50, tick spacing 5).
Panel (a) legend has two header columns 'C (wt%) YS UTS' with C rows 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.2, where open symbols denote yield strength and filled symbols ultimate tensile strength.
Panel (a) legend assigns Mn (wt%) values 8, 10, 11 and 12 to red, pink, blue and dark-green marker colours respectively.
Panel (a) contains the printed annotation 'γ-based duplex (γ+α/δ)' in the lower-left of the plot area.
In panel (a) the data points span roughly 5–45% elongation and approximately 400–1450 MPa, with the highest strengths at the lowest elongations (near 8–15%).
Panel (b) axes are the same quantities with wider ranges: strength 0–2000 MPa and elongation 0–100%.
Panel (b) shows a cyan shaded field arrow-labelled 'γ-based duplex (γ+α/δ)' at low elongation and a grey elongated shaded field arrow-labelled 'single-γ' that extends to about 100% elongation.
Panel (b) legend lists carbon contents ≤0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, >1.2 (open = YS, filled = UTS) and Mn (wt%) ranges 12~18 (magenta), 18~25 (orange), 25~28 (purple), 28~40 (dark red).
Panel (b) data points reach elongations up to ~80–100% at relatively low strengths while points near 1800–1900 MPa occur only at low elongation.

The caption states that (a) corresponds to steels with an average Mn content and (b) to steels with high Mn content, measured at room temperature, and that the figure is reproduced under a CC BY license from reference [8].
The citing text states that Figure 4 shows the influence of Mn and C concentration on the mechanical properties of Fe–Mn–Al–C steel.
Neither panel prints numeric data labels on individual points; all plotted values must be read from the axis gridlines only.
